category: Objects with a Primary Rotational or Spinning Function
explanation: Ferris wheels, record players, washing machines, and merry-go-rounds all perform their main function through a continuous rotational or spinning movement. A trampoline operates primarily by vertical bouncing.

The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Colossus of Rhodes, and Lighthouse of Alexandria are all traditionally recognized as four of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Machu Picchu is one of the New7Wonders of the World, not an ancient wonder from the original list.
Law, heart, record, and silence can all be 'broken' in a metaphorical or abstract sense (violated, saddened, surpassed, interrupted). A bone is physically broken.
